title: Canesten Disinfectant and Laundry Sanitiser Lemon 2L $11.87 ($10.68 S&S) + Delivery ($0 Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)
body:
Deal: Canesten Disinfectant and Laundry Sanitiser Lemon 2L $11.87 ($10.68 S&S) + Delivery ($0 Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)

[spock] Better off with Aldi equivalent $8 2ltr same ingredients.
[PainToad] How do you know someone shops at Aldi? Don't worry, they'll tell ya.
[fantombloo] If it's mentioning a bargain then I'm glad they do.
[Mjk698] Love how Aldi beats the competitors on pretty much everything 😜
[PainToad] No different to Woolworths and Coles homebrands being cheaper than brand names. There's nothing special about Aldi.
[Mjk698] It's been found a lot of ALDI products are actually repackaged brand name items they've been in the news a lot, won a lot of reviews!
[PainToad] @Mjk698: Lots of homebrand products are like that. Aldi isn't special.
they've been in the news a lot,
Paid infomercials masquerading as news.
[Mjk698] @PainToad: Home brand are generally cheap low quality I prefer ALDI quality and standing up against the big guys
[PainToad] @Mjk698:
standing up against the big guys
Aldi is an international German company. They are the big guys.
[Mjk698] @PainToad: Least they aren't ripping us off like our own so called people
[MrFrugalSpend] @Mjk698: Yeah but by the same token, an estimated 40-50% of the Coles and Woolworths ASX listed companies are Australian investor owned - a lot of which is our own super funds and more retained earnings stay here than repatriate to the international Aldi HQ in Germany… they also employ a lot more Australians and have huge supply chain spends in Australia which boost our economy … they also anchor larger shopping centres we like having in our communities, pay more tax, rent, rates and other benefits. … Aldi does some of that, but to a much lesser extent… and they are doing just as much usual business things (aka "ripping off") as Colesworth - it's just got better marketing sentiment being 'good different' in a country that was crying out for more choice to keep them honest after having little choice other than the Duopoly for decades… but buy the specials between each, home brands, engage in everyday rewards and/or flybuys and Onepass bonus and nowadays, regular gift card sales on each, fuel discounts, etc - and you aren't much worse off at Colesworth (but credit where due, Aldi does keep them more honest now its got a grip than before)
[crunchyhead] Aldi is a knock-off supermarket and yes, their knock-offs are cheaper than name brands.
So is every other knock-off brand sold by anybody else.
[dlovep] Last time I heard "My friend…" I hang up straight away….LOL

Greetings, friend. Do you wish to look as happy as me? Well, you've got the power inside you right now. Use it, and send one dollar to Happy Dude, 742 Evergreen Terrace, Springfield. Don't delay, eternal happiness is just a dollar away.

Same ingredients as the Aldi one for $7.49/2L, and I think the cotton fresh is okay, though not as 'disinfectanty' as lemon. Was $6.99 until recently though.
[deepfriedchips] same ingredients and same quantities of said ingredients?
[ATangk] Same active ingredient anyways.
Benzalkonium chloride 70g/L
[outlander] Meaning you could buy some pool algaecide from Aldi for $8 during the summer season, and get the equivalent of 5.7L worth
[bobvegas] @outlander: They contain a dark blue dye which the laundry sanitisers don't have, once diluted to laundry strength it would still be very blue, because the dilution is only from 150g/ to 70g/l. My concern would be blue clothes
[outlander] @bobvegas: The one I bought was orange and is 40% concentration.
[truongster] Really just a preference on scent + free delivery & discounted GCs for Prime members.

[PainToad] @RtN: I read on the Aldi Australia Reddit that the shelf checkouts are always closed because Aldi limits stores to about 4 staff and there's never enough staff to run the shelf checkouts.
Aldi is an absolute joke with dogshit customer service. Why people put up with their shit is beyond me.
[RtN] @PainToad: I think for penny pinching purposes they put up with it, I generally only go when some interesting special buy comes up and even then. "Off Peak" times.
[Buttershoes] @PainToad: No need, the person on the checkout can control the self checkouts from their computer.
[RtN] Anyone know out of all which is best? for e.g. vs Dettol Antibacterial Laundry Sanitiser Fresh Cotton 2.5L
[carrawa] Remote + more expensive to deliver.
Lots of stuff like this now. Can order one flavour of the same brand of noodles but not the other/s. Defeats the purpose of membership or free delivery.
[Oofy Doofy] Sodium percarbonate is better and cheaper than this.
Not to mention issues with microbial & fungal resistance when using QACs like this.
[Kategs] For what it's worth to anyone experiencing eczema or unexplained dermatitis, this product (specifically Benzalkonium chloride) caused my son HORRIFIC eczema - to the point that he ended up in hospital. The dermatologist immediately asked what laundry products I used. They told me to cease using any product with Benzalkonium chloride and stressed that it very commonly causes severe skin issues. I stopped and my son has had completely clear skin for 4 years. We haven't made any other changes to his diet or lifestyle or skincare.
[Davbar24] We switched to Clean laundry sanitiser from woolies $4 a litre same thing. Slightly different smell but not over powering.
[bcYield] Is this better/cheaper than the all-purpose spray?
